summary: @c1-ease/commerce ships a postinstall + import-time beacon to a hardcoded VPS
details: The package is a stub whose index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property access, providing no advertised functionality. Its real behavior is a reconnaissance beacon in beacon.cjs, invoked both from the declared postinstall lifecycle script and from index.js on require(). The beacon POSTs host identifiers — package name, os.hostname(), the absolute install path, process.cwd(), node version, and a userAgent string — to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc on a Contabo VPS, with TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The destination is unrelated to any legitimate publisher infrastructure, and the scoped name combined with the no-op Proxy export is consistent with a dependency-confusion or typosquat lure whose sole purpose is this callback.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
